items.title: Factors that can change the allelic frequencies (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Factors that can change the allelic frequencies: a main subheading of 24.2.2 Neo-Darwinism, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 218-219.

blocks.text: Neeche woh factors hain jin ki wajah se Hardy-Weinberg ki sharten poori nahin hotin aur ek nasl se doosri nasl tak alleles ki frequencies badal jati hain.

Jab ittefaqi waqiaat (chance events) population mein genes ki frequencies ko badal dein to is tabdeeli ko genetic drift kehte hain. Natural selection ke bar-aks yeh tabdeeliyan fitness (behtar dhalne) ki wajah se nahin balke ittefaq se hoti hain, aur chhoti populations mein sab se zyada wazeh hoti hain. Genetic drift ko aksar neutral selection bhi kehte hain. Misaal: aag ki wajah se khargoshon ki population 100 se ghat kar 10 reh jati hai. Bache hue khargosh ittefaq se zyada tar bhoore (brown) hain, is liye nahin ke woh behtar dhale hue the. Nayi population mein genetic diversity (genes ki qismein) kam hogi.

blocks.alt: Baayen: 100 khargosh (mile jule bhoore aur safaid nuqte). Surkh teer 'fire'. Daayen: 10 bache hue, 9 bhoore aur 1 safaid: ittefaq se zyada tar bhoore.
blocks.caption: Aag ke baad genetic drift: kitab ki khargosh wali misaal (asal khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi, sirf Roman Urdu ke liye).

blocks.text: Hardy-Weinberg theorem yeh maan kar chalta hai ke koi fard bahar se population mein dakhil nahin hota (immigrate) aur koi fard population chhor kar nahin jata (emigrate). Doosri population se afraad ke aane se nayi mutations aa sakti hain jo foran genes ki frequency badal deti hain (yani evolution). Afraad ki migration (aane jane) se genes ki frequency mein tabdeeli ko gene flow kehte hain.

Hardy-Weinberg theorem yeh maanta hai ke mutations nahin hotin, ya mutational equilibrium (mutations ka barabar tawazun) maujood hai. Lekin mutations zindagi ki haqeeqat hain. Sab se ahem baat yeh hai ke mutations tamam naye genes ka asal (origin) hain aur aise farq (variations) ka zariya hain jo jandar ke liye adaptive (faida-mand) sabit ho sakte hain. Mutations is baat ko bhi yaqeeni banati hain ke population mein aise farq maujood rahein jin ki madad se group mahol ke achanak jhatkon (environmental shocks) mein behtar tareeqe se bach sake.

Mutations ke asar mukhtalif hote hain. Zyada tar mutations nuqsan-deh (deleterious) hoti hain. Kuch neutral hoti hain, ya ek mahol mein nuqsan-deh aur doosre mahol mein jandar ko zinda rehne mein madad deti hain. Mutational equilibrium tab hota hai jab wild-type allele se mutant banne wali mutation, mutant se wapas wild-type banne wali mutation ke barabar ho. Is ka asar allele frequency par aisa hi hai jaise koi mutation hui hi na ho. Lekin mutational equilibrium shayad hi kabhi hota hai. Mutation pressure is baat ka paimana (measure) hai ke mutation ki wajah se genes ki frequencies kitna badalne ka rujhan rakhti hain.

blocks.prompt: Phool ke rang ke 1000 genes mein se 300 safaid rang ke hain. Safaid allele ki frequency kya hai?

items: Neo-Darwinism: evolution = gene pool mein alleles ki frequency ki tabdeeli; yeh Hardy-Weinberg theorem par qaim hai.
Hardy-Weinberg (1908): bari, random mating wali population mein, migration, mutation aur selection na hon to frequencies har nasl mein ek jaisi rehti hain.
Frequencies badalne wale factors: genetic drift (ittefaq, chhoti population), gene flow (afraad ka aana jana) aur mutation (naye genes ka asal).
